newsitem.title: ITALY: FORECAST-Italy money mkt sees rates down further.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST-Italy money mkt sees rates down further.

text.p: Italy's money market sees short term interest rates falling further on all maturities, a study based on implicit forward rates by the Bocconi University research arm Igier said on Friday.
The study showed the implicit overnight rate at 8.22 percent in one month's time from an actual level of 8.75 percent on Thursday, the day on which Igier carried out its study.
One week ago, the implicit overnight rate on a one month timeframe was seen at 8.54 percent, while a month ago it was seen standing at 9.11 percent four weeks later.
On a three month horizon, the implicit overnight rate is expected to edge down to 8.32 percent. One week ago, still on the three-month horizon, it was forecast at 8.42 percent.
On a one year timeframe the implicit overnight rate is seen at 7.98 percent. One week ago on a three month horizon it was seen standing at 8.31 percent.

The spread between the implicit Italian overnight rate and the implied German overnight rate in two years' time, which is considered a good indicator of market confidence in prospects for Europe's economic and monetary union, is at 329 basis points from 332 basis points forecast a week ago. One month ago this spread was at 301 basis points.
